findings.problem: 姬無霜的基本外觀寫死了她頸後也有一個月牙胎記（平常被頭髮蓋住）。這幾鏡都把她列進 characters、鏡頭在她背後，prompt 卻沒寫頭髮蓋住頸後；第四幕灘頭的寫手在每個背面鏡都寫了這一句，第三幕和第五幕沒寫。生圖如果把她頸後的月牙畫出來，就等於在 a05 之前把母子同一個記號攤給觀眾，也違反分場表「本集不拍姬無霜的頸後」。a03-s029 風險最高：從她左後方拍、她低頭看茶盞，正是 a03-s056 拍出洛青衍胎記的那個姿勢。
findings.evidence: cast.json ji-wushuang appearance：a small crescent birthmark on the back of her neck usually hidden under her hair。a03-s029「From Wushuang's left rear at the south … her head bowed toward the small white porcelain teacup」，這一鏡的 nape covered 只寫給洛青衍；a03-s053「Wushuang at her low black lacquered table in the right foreground, her back to the camera under her phoenix crown」；對照 a04-s076「her loose silver-white hair covering the back of her neck」、a04-s085「her loose silver-white hair hiding the back of her neck」。
findings.fix: 在這十鏡描述姬無霜的地方加上 her loose silver-white hair covering the back of her neck。a03-s029 把 her head bowed toward the small white porcelain teacup 改成 her face turned down toward the small white porcelain teacup, her loose silver-white hair covering the back of her neck，構圖與遮臉的銀鏈照舊。

findings.problem: 全集最後一鏡要拍她包著布條的手的影子橫在繡布上，可是倒數第五鏡 a05-s087 已經把那隻手收回膝上，a05-s088 到 a05-s090 都沒有手回到案上，到了 a05-s091 手又出現在畫面右緣、影子落在絹上。手要擋在燈與絹之間才投得出影子。
